visual.general_description: Four-part composite of grayscale ultrasound photographs, one showing a large dark cystic structure with a red arrow.
visual.detailed_description: Grayscale ultrasound images arranged as a two-by-two grid separated by white lines, apparently photographed from a screen or print. Top left: a large rounded dark (anechoic) cavity with a thin bright wall, a few small bright specks inside its lower part, and a red arrow at the upper wall pointing toward the structure from the upper right; the upper left corner of the image is covered by a solid black rectangle, with the printed text LOGIQ below it. Printed text along the top edge of the top left quadrant, to the right of the black rectangle, reads MI 1.4, TIs 1.3, 12.9 and Abd.Ped, with a partly cut-off character. Top right and bottom right: ultrasound images of layered echogenic bands above darker regions, with no arrows, calipers or labels. Bottom left: an ultrasound image with yellow dotted calipers across a small elongated structure near the top and a measurement box listing two lines, the first reading L 1.21 cm and the second reading L 0.50 cm, with partly legible yellow text beside it. No panel letters are printed.

visual.general_description: Three CT sections, each showing a large rounded gray mass in the abdomen.
visual.detailed_description: Three contrast-enhanced-appearing abdominal CT images side by side, with the letters a, b and c printed at the lower right of the first, second and third image. Image b is a narrower coronal-appearing section with a large rounded gray mass and a thin bright linear focus near its upper border, beside the liver outline above and part of the bowel. Image c is an axial section with a large rounded homogeneous gray mass occupying the upper left of the image, bowel loops to its right, two brighter kidneys in the lower half and a vertebral body at the bottom center. Tiny, illegible overlay text appears near the upper corners of images a and b. No arrows, measurements or side markers are legible.

visual.general_description: Operative photograph of a large pink twisted mass delivered through a lower abdominal incision.
visual.detailed_description: Color photograph of a draped patient abdomen in green surgical drapes. A low abdominal incision with a wound edge shows a rounded pink-red surface with fine branching vessels protruding from it. A narrow twisted stalk leads from it to a larger oval smooth pink to purple-gray mass with visible surface vessels lying on the drapes to the right of the image. The navel is visible above the incision. No text, labels, arrows or panel letters are visible and no face is visible.
